title: What Happens When You Get a Charley Horse?
description:
A charley horse is a muscle cramp: a sudden tightening, most often in the calf, where the muscle contracts on its own and can't relax. It can last from a few seconds to 10 minutes, and most people get them at night or while resting. Stretching and massaging the muscle, or putting your weight on that leg, may ease it, and the muscle can stay sore afterward. See a doctor if cramps happen often, are severe, or come with swelling or numbness.
